name: Obsidian
description: Obsidian is a note-taking app that stores notes as local plain-text Markdown files and lets users link notes together to build a personal, interconnected knowledge base, with an emphasis on local-first data ownership.
best_for: Described by the vendor as the free and flexible app for private thoughts — positioned for individuals who want full ownership and privacy of their personal notes and knowledge bases.
features: Bi-directional linking and backlinks between notes
Canvas for visual brainstorming and diagramming
Optional end-to-end encrypted sync across devices

alternatives.name: Notion
alternatives.description: An all-in-one workspace combining documents, databases, project tracking, and team knowledge.
alternatives.best_for: People who want a cloud-hosted, team-friendly workspace instead of local files

alternatives.name: Confluence
alternatives.description: Atlassian's team workspace for documentation, meeting notes, and internal knowledge.

alternatives.name: GitBook
alternatives.description: A documentation platform for building and maintaining technical or product documentation, kept in sync with code.
alternatives.best_for: Teams publishing developer or product documentation

tiers.name: Obsidian app
tiers.notes: Described as free without limits, with no sign-up required. A commercial license is not required.

tiers.name: Obsidian Sync
tiers.notes: $4 per user per month billed annually; $5 per user per month billed monthly. Includes cross-device sync, end-to-end encryption, version history and shared vaults.

tiers.name: Obsidian Publish
tiers.notes: $8 per site per month billed annually; $10 per site per month billed monthly.

tiers.name: Commercial license (optional)
tiers.notes: Optional $50 per user per year for organizations that want to support development.

cons: Cross-device sync, version history and shared-vault collaboration are part of the paid Obsidian Sync add-on ($4 per user per month billed annually, $5 billed monthly), not the free app
Publishing notes to the web needs the separate paid Obsidian Publish add-on, priced per site
